activity.notes: Representative span from Fugger's assumption of a leading position in the family enterprise around 1495 through his death in 1525, covering his major mining, banking, and Habsburg finance activities.

sources.title: Meet the Fuggers: Jakob the Rich and his family — Europeana
sources.citation_text: Europeana describes Jakob Fugger's expansion of the family business, mining and banking interests, and financing of Habsburg power including Charles V's imperial election.
